verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or reports about macOS supporting modern IDEs (Xcode, VS Code, JetBrains), toolchains, or AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, CUDA equivalents, etc.); it only covers Continuity features, security incidents, and CLI utilities like pbcopy/fs_usage, none of which address the story's subject. Some community evidence even shows macOS causing developer friction (exec/getxattr network stalls affecting 'terraform apply'), but this doesn't constitute evidence for or against IDE/toolchain/AI-ML currency. missing for 10: any mention of Xcode/VS Code/JetBrains support, language toolchain updates, GPU/ML framework compatibility, or first-party AI/ML SDK support on macOS.
